aboutPage.title: Turnkey Car Import & Delivery from the USA
aboutPage.subtitle: We guide you through every step: from careful selection at leading auctions to receiving your keys in Ukraine.
aboutPage.whyTitle: Why Buy a Car from the USA?
aboutPage.whySubtitle: Buying a vehicle at American auctions offers several significant advantages compared to the European or domestic market.

whyItems.title: Save Up to 40%
whyItems.description: Even when including shipping and customs clearance fees, importing a car from the USA is significantly cheaper than buying a similar one in Ukraine.

whyItems.title: Transparent History (CARFAX)
whyItems.description: You receive a complete vehicle history report: number of owners, mileage, maintenance records, and all accidents.

whyItems.title: Premium Trim Levels
whyItems.description: The American market offers cars with top configurations, powerful engines, and unique options.

whyItems.title: Honest Mileage
whyItems.description: Odometer tampering is a criminal offense in the US. You can be 100% confident in the authenticity of the mileage.

aboutPage.processTitle: How Does the Delivery Process Work?
aboutPage.processSubtitle: Simple and transparent stages of cooperation that guarantee the safety of your purchase.

processSteps.title: Selection & History Check
processSteps.description: We analyze your requirements, search for the best options on Copart, IAAI, and Manheim, and thoroughly check the history of each vehicle.

processSteps.title: Signing the Contract
processSteps.description: We sign an official contract detailing the car requirements, the maximum budget, and our obligations.

processSteps.title: Bidding at the Auction
processSteps.description: We participate in the bidding for the chosen car and purchase it at the most favorable price.

processSteps.title: Shipping to Port & Ukraine
processSteps.description: We transport the car to the nearest US port, load it into a container, ship it to Europe, and then deliver it to Ukraine via a car hauler.

processSteps.title: Customs Clearance
processSteps.description: Professional brokers carry out fast and cost-effective customs clearance in accordance with Ukrainian legislation.

processSteps.title: Repair & Certification
processSteps.description: If necessary, we assist with finding high-quality spare parts, repair services, and passing the mandatory state certification.

aboutPage.ctaSubtitle: Use our online calculator or submit a request, and our manager will select the best options for your budget.
